claims.statement: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen had gone to Australia.
claims.excerpt: Joe Coburn is in Auburn prison, Joe Goss in a Kentucky prison, Jem Mace a fugitive in Canada, Clark and Weeden are in jail in New Jersey, and Tom Allen has gone te Australia.

notes: Other papers that month placed Allen in Canada; this is the Post-Dispatch's report only.
